name: unofficial-uwm-mortgage-reader
description: Community-contributed, unofficial, read-only mortgage reader for the UWM servicing portal.

interface.longDescription: An independent, community-contributed mortgage reader for a user's own UWM servicing portal. Not made, sponsored, supported, endorsed, or operated by UWM, and does not speak for UWM. Credentials and MFA stay in 1Password or the user's headed browser; no payment or account-mutation tools are included.
defaultPrompt: Connect my mortgage with the unofficial community reader.
Review my mortgage using read-only data.
Compare extra principal with keeping cash.
